theorem fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius (i : Fin ℓ) (steps : ℕ)
    [NeZero steps] (h_i_add_steps : i.val + steps ≤ ℓ)
    (f : OracleFunction 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  (h_fw_dist_lt : fiberwiseClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    (i := i) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (f := f)) :
  hammingClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ f := by
  let C := BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩
  let d := fiberwiseDistance 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f
  let S := (fun g : C => (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g).ncard) '' Set.univ
  obtain ⟨g, _, hg⟩ := Nat.sInf_mem (Set.image_nonempty.mpr Set.univ_nonempty : S.Nonempty)
  let Y := fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g
  letI : Fintype Y := Fintype.ofFinite Y
  change Y.ncard = d at hg
  let D := Finset.univ.filter (fun x => f x ≠ g.val x)
  let q := iteratedQuotientMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i steps h_i_add_steps
  let k := pointToIterateQuotientIndex (𝔽q := 𝔽q) (β := β) (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps)
  have hr x : qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := steps)
      (h_i_add_steps := fin_ℓ_steps_lt_ℓ_add_R i steps h_i_add_steps) (q x) (k x) = x :=
    (is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps x (q x)).mp rfl
  have hd : hammingDist f g ≤ Y.ncard * 2 ^ steps := by
    have h := Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn (fun x => (q x, k x))
      (s := D) (t := Y.toFinset ×ˢ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (2 ^ steps))))
      (by
        intro x hx
        simp only [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_product, Set.mem_toFinset, Finset.mem_univ, and_true]
        exact ⟨x, rfl, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2⟩)
      (by
        intro x hx z hz h
        obtain ⟨hq, hk⟩ := Prod.mk.inj h
        rw [←hr x, ←hr z, hq, hk])
    simpa only [D, hammingDist, Finset.card_product, Finset.card_univ,
      Fintype.card_fin, ← Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card'] using h
  have hb : 2 * d ≤ 2 ^ (ℓ + 𝓡 - (i.val + steps)) - 2 ^ (ℓ - (i.val + steps)) :=
    Nat.le_of_lt_succ (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.1 h_fw_dist_lt)
  have ha : (2 ^ (ℓ + 𝓡 - (i.val + steps)) - 2 ^ (ℓ - (i.val + steps))) * 2 ^ steps =
      2 ^ (ℓ + 𝓡 - i.val) - 2 ^ (ℓ - i.val) := by
    rw [Nat.sub_mul, ←Nat.pow_add, ←Nat.pow_add,
      show ℓ + 𝓡 - (i.val + steps) + steps = ℓ + 𝓡 - i.val by omega,
      show ℓ - (i.val + steps) + steps = ℓ - i.val by omega]
  have hn : 2 * hammingDist f g < BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i, by omega⟩ := by
    apply Nat.lt_succ_of_le
    calc
      2 * hammingDist f g ≤ 2 * (Y.ncard * 2 ^ steps) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 hd
      _ = (2 * d) * 2 ^ steps := by rw [hg, mul_assoc]
      _ ≤ (2 ^ (ℓ + 𝓡 - (i.val + steps)) - 2 ^ (ℓ - (i.val + steps))) * 2 ^ steps :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hb
      _ = _ := ha
  unfold hammingClose
  apply (mul_le_mul_left' (Code.distFromCode_le_dist_to_mem f g g.property) 2).trans_lt
  exact_mod_cast hn
